proof_scope: Session-trace -> walkthrough generation (run.sh spec-from-proof): a real captured debug session (debugger.proof.v1 from run.sh break) becomes a runnable debugger.walkthrough.v1 spec with no hand-authored JSON -- stops in true session order (first hit per file:line), expect pinned to the first observed locals, launch module + PYTHONPATH derived, repeat-counts narrated. Fail-closed: a zero-hit proof and a proof that fails independent validation both refuse to generate. The live case runs a freshly generated spec through the real VS Code bridge to WALKTHROUGH-COMPLETE.

claims.proves: run.sh break -> spec-from-proof produces a schema-valid spec whose stops/expect mirror the session's first hits in chronological order; zero-hit and tampered proofs are refused with SPEC-GENERATION-REFUSED; and a generated spec replays over the live bridge to WALKTHROUGH-COMPLETE with every expect matching
claims.does_not_prove: narration quality of the optional --narrate rewrite (fail-soft, model-dependent), or generation from bridge stop receipts (proof.v1 headless captures only)

cases.name: capture-to-spec-session-order
cases.description: A real 2-breakpoint capture (6 hits) generates a 2-stop spec in session order (tally:12 hits before main:20), with expect pinned to first-hit locals and the launch module derived.
command:
set -euo pipefail; SKILL="$(cd .. && pwd)"; T=$(mktemp -d); P="$T/proof.json"; S="$T/spec.json"; cd "$SKILL/scenarios/variable_state"; "$SKILL/run.sh" break main.py:20 --break "$PWD/tally.py:12" --local seen --local value --local first --out "$P" -- python3 main.py >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; "$SKILL/run.sh" spec-from-proof "$P" --out "$S" --workspace "$(cd "$SKILL/../.." && pwd)"; python3 - "$S" <<'PYEOF'
import json, sys
d = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
assert d["schema"] == "debugger.walkthrough.v1"
stops = d["stops"]
assert [ (s["file"].split("/")[-1], s["line"]) for s in stops ] == [("tally.py", 12), ("main.py", 20)], stops
assert stops[0]["expect"] == {"seen": "[1]", "value": "1"}, stops[0]
assert stops[1]["expect"] == {"first": "6"}, stops[1]
assert d["launch"]["module"] == "main" and "variable_state" in d["launch"]["env"][0], d["launch"]
assert "5 times" in stops[0]["say"], stops[0]["say"]
print("SPEC-SESSION-ORDER-CORRECT")
PYEOF

cases.name: zero-hit-proof-refused
cases.description: A proof with zero hits refuses generation: there is no session to walk through.
command: set -uo pipefail; SKILL="$(cd .. && pwd)"; T=$(mktemp -d); printf '{"hit_count": 0, "hits": [], "command": ["python3", "x.py"]}' > "$T/empty.json"; "$SKILL/run.sh" spec-from-proof "$T/empty.json" --out "$T/spec.json"; rc=$?; [ $rc -eq 1 ] && [ ! -f "$T/spec.json" ] && exit 0 || { echo "UNEXPECTED rc=$rc"; exit 1; }

cases.name: tampered-proof-refused
cases.description: A proof that fails independent validation (hand-edited proofValid over a stop that never happened) refuses generation via the run.sh validate gate.
command:
set -uo pipefail; SKILL="$(cd .. && pwd)"; T=$(mktemp -d); python3 - "$T" <<'PYEOF'
import json, sys
d = json.load(open('proofs/canonical-tampered-proofvalid.json'))
d['hit_count'] = 1
d['hits'] = [{'file': '/tmp/sample.py', 'function': 'classify', 'line': 2, 'locals': {'value': '14'}, 'source': 'label = value'}]
d['command'] = ['python3', '/tmp/sample.py']
json.dump(d, open(sys.argv[1] + '/tampered.json', 'w'))
PYEOF
"$SKILL/run.sh" spec-from-proof "$T/tampered.json" --out "$T/spec.json"; rc=$?; [ $rc -eq 1 ] && [ ! -f "$T/spec.json" ] && exit 0 || { echo "UNEXPECTED rc=$rc"; exit 1; }

cases.name: generated-spec-replays-live
cases.description: A freshly captured-and-generated spec runs through the live VS Code bridge to WALKTHROUGH-COMPLETE with every expect matching.
command: set -uo pipefail; WS="${DEBUGGER_VSCODE_WORKSPACE:-}"; [ -z "$WS" ] && { echo BRIDGE_BLOCKED; exit 0; }; SKILL="$WS/skills/debugger"; T=$(mktemp -d); P="$T/proof.json"; S="$T/spec.json"; cd "$SKILL/scenarios/variable_state"; "$SKILL/run.sh" break main.py:20 --break "$PWD/tally.py:12" --local seen --local value --local first --out "$P" -- python3 main.py >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; "$SKILL/run.sh" spec-from-proof "$P" --out "$S" --workspace "$WS" >/dev/null; (cd "$WS" && timeout 280 "$SKILL/run.sh" walkthrough "$S" --commands 'continue;continue' --wait-seconds 60) | grep -E 'WALKTHROUGH-COMPLETE' || { echo BRIDGE_BLOCKED; exit 0; }
